question: Which exact-target LVGL image and bar functions implement semantic Image and Progress nodes?
prototype_hypothesis: Image create(parent)->object, image set_src(object, source); bar create(parent)->object, set_range(object,min,max), set_value(object,value,animation_enabled)
callsite_evidence: lv_img_create 0x0C261644 allocates the LVGL v8 image class and has 594 code xrefs
lv_img_set_src 0x0C2645F8 contains exact lv_img_set_src diagnostics and source-type handling; 766 code xrefs
lv_bar_create 0x0C262EC8 creates the LVGL v8 bar class; 13 code xrefs
lv_bar_set_range 0x0C25E57C is identified by exact source diagnostics and 47 code xrefs
lv_bar_set_value 0x0C25E53C clamps against bar min/max fields, stores current value, and branches on animation; 69 code xrefs
0x0C25E400 is excluded: it is the bar class constructor callback, not lv_bar_set_value
control_flow_evidence: constructors allocate the recovered widget class and initialize it
setters are reached from stock firmware widget paths on the UI owner thread
ownership_analysis: Created widgets are owned by the firmware page tree. Image source storage must remain valid while referenced; Canopus backends retain page-owned descriptors and buffers. Bar setters borrow the widget only.
unsafe_assumptions: No device probe has yet exercised the new Canopus Image/Progress rendering path
Image descriptor format and cache lifetime are reviewed separately before dynamic pixel sources are enabled
recommended_probe: Create one image and one progress bar on a disposable page; update source/range/value, hide, resume, and destroy the page.
